title: fix(cli): reject prematurely terminated text generation streams
author: ale-rls

gist.summary: The Polli CLI now rejects text-generation SSE streams that reach EOF before `[DONE]`, rather than accepting incomplete output. Existing command error handling then fails text commands and rolls back interrupted chat turns. A regression test covers content followed by EOF without `[DONE]`. The PR also reports a CLI prerelease version and standalone lockfile update.
